name: Create Technology & Science Co.,Ltd.
summary: Create Technology & Science Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high-voltage porcelain insulators for power transmission and transformation, clean environmental protection equipment, and engineering in China and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Clean Environmental Protection Equipment and Engineering, High-Voltage Insulators for Power Transmission and Distribution, Precision Bearings, Measuring Instruments, Abrasives and Grinding Wheels, and Trading and Services.
